summary: Knightscope filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement amending its July 2025 at-the-market (ATM) program to raise the authorized amount to up to $35.0 million of Class A common stock, comprising $2,504,533 remaining from the prior authorization plus $32,495,467 of newly authorized shares. Cumulative sales under the Sales Agreement with H.C. Wainwright total $47,495,467. Shares are listed on Nasdaq under KSCP; last sale price was $1.14 on September 18, 2026. This is a routine shelf takedown amendment, not a special situation; dilution and absorption capacity remain the watch items.
